beats.text: Watch this. An AI opens a spreadsheet, builds a chart and saves it as a PDF. Nobody touches the mouse.
It's GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI's most powerful model. And India searches for it more than any other country.
But most people can't even find it. Here's how it works, in one minute.
Astra isn't in the normal chat list. On ChatGPT Plus, it lives inside two places: Work and Codex.
Step one: open the ChatGPT desktop app and switch from Chat to Work.
Step two: choose Astra, then turn on Computer Use in Plugins.
Step three: start your request with at Computer, and say exactly what the finished job looks like.
Astra asks your permission before it touches any app, and you can watch every single click.
On Plus, about nineteen ninety-nine rupees a month in India, OpenAI estimates five to forty-five Astra messages every five hours. Free and Go don't include it.
And any site promising free Astra? Skip it. That's a scam.
